name: DTMAPI 强力种植枪
author: DTMAPI
description: DTMAPI experimental 强力种植枪。扩展官方种植枪为种子、保护膜、肥料多槽使用。

localized_description.schinese: 扩展官方种植枪，让同一把枪可携带种子、保护膜和肥料，并按官方地块规则依次处理。
localized_description.tchinese: 擴展官方種植槍，讓同一把槍可攜帶種子、保護膜和肥料，並按官方地塊規則依次處理。
localized_description.english: Extends the official farming gun so one gun can carry seeds, films, and fertilizers and apply them through official basin rules.
